title: Design System: PIA — Pakistan International Airlines (concept)

display.purpose: Page-hero H1 over emerald wash; one weight, inscriptional, ghost-word doubled behind itself.

headline.purpose: Section H2 in ink, always over the engraved gold double rule.

body.purpose: All working text; ink at /70 alpha, capped near 62ch.

label.purpose: Footer column titles and the NOTICE tag only; gold-on-emerald on dark grounds. Never a kicker above headings.

data.purpose: Airport codes, fares, times, PNRs, chips; tabular numerals; never prose.

urdu.purpose: City names in Nastaliq; RTL isolated, line-height 2.1.

shadows.name: contact
shadows.purpose: Resting .panel shadow; the plate sits on the ground.

shadows.name: mounted
shadows.purpose: .panel-thick over the takeoff film or photography.

shadows.name: recessed
shadows.purpose: The .well form-field interior; carved, not floating.

shadows.name: tablet
shadows.purpose: Emerald stone regions; shadow tinted with their own green.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: .panel-hover with translateY(-2px) and border brightening to full gold.

shadows.name: double-rule-inset
shadows.purpose: The engraved inner rule every plate carries 3px inside its border.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The only easing: panel hover (0.5s) and scroll reveal (0.8s). Stone settles, it does not fly.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: The page's entrance grammar for content blocks.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: Route-map inlay threads drawing in on load.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Hard invariant across reveal, route-draw, hover transforms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled action: PIA Emerald with an inner ivory keyline.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--pia-green, #006937); color: #f3eee3; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(243,238,227,0.25), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,105,55,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006937; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inlaid Panel
components.description: The raised ivory plate with the engraved gold double rule 3px inside its border.
components.html:
Executive Economy

The premium cabin: wider seats, priority boarding, and a dedicated check-in counter.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #faf6ec; border: 1px solid rgba(164,141,41,0.45); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #faf6ec, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(164,141,41,0.28), 0 2px 10px -4px rgba(29,42,35,0.22); padding: 20px; color: #1d2a23; transition: border-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-panel:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #a48d29; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #faf6ec, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(164,141,41,0.45), 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(29,42,35,0.30); } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(29,42,35,0.7); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Emerald Tablet
components.description: The carved green stone region: emerald under a subtle sheen, gold engraving, ivory text.
components.html: PK 301 · KHI — LHEON TIME
components.css: .ds-tablet { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), rgba(0,0,0,0.14)), #0d3b26; border: 1px solid rgba(164,141,41,0.45); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #0d3b26, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(164,141,41,0.55), 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(13,59,38,0.55); color: #f3eee3; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-tablet-code { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; } .ds-tablet-chip { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: #75dc86; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Well Field
components.description: The recessed form field: label always visible above a mono-face value.
components.css: .ds-well { display: block; background: #fffdf6; border: 1px solid rgba(29,42,35,0.22); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(29,42,35,0.10); padding: 10px 14px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-well:focus-within { border-color: #006937; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(29,42,35,0.08), 0 0 0 1px #006937; } .ds-well-label { display: block; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(29,42,35,0.6); } .ds-well:focus-within .ds-well-label { color: #006937; } .ds-well-input { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1d2a23; caret-color: #006937; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Mono status pill; color from currentColor per state.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: #006937; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation in the ivory lintel; active state is a gold underline.
components.html: BookDestinationsFleet
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; background: #f3eee3; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(164,141,41,0.45); padding: 12px 20px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(29,42,35,0.6); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding-bottom: 4px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1d2a23; } .ds-nav-active { color: #1d2a23; border-bottom-color: #a48d29; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006937; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Ruled Heading
components.description: The section heading grammar: inscriptional Marcellus over the engraved gold double rule.
components.css: .ds-heading-title { font-family: 'Marcellus', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: #1d2a23; margin: 0; } .ds-double-rule { height: 5px; width: 96px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(164,141,41,0.45); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(164,141,41,0.45); margin-top: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
The booking hall is a Mughal marble court. The page is an ivory stone ground structured by inlaid cartouche borders and pierced jali screens; it refuses the dark-glass photo-hero airline default and the white-minimal opposite alike. Everything is stone: raised surfaces are inlaid plates, form fields are recessed carvings, the dark regions are carved emerald tablets with gold engraving. The two brand colors are the ones PIA's own logo already carries — the wordmark's emerald and the calligraphic mark's gold — and each has one job: emerald fills whole regions, gold draws lines.

Density is architectural rather than busy: full-height snap sections, one inscriptional headline per section over an engraved double rule, generous ivory around every plate. Motion is stone motion — surfaces settle (a short damped rise), inlay threads draw in; nothing flies, blurs, or goes translucent. prefers-reduced-motion disables all of it.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory marble ground with jali-lattice watermarks at the page edges (6% opacity)
Gold is engraved line-work only: double rules, hairlines, inlay threads
Emerald commits at region scale: departures tablet, footer, filled actions
Cusped ogee arch clips every featured photograph
Inscriptional Marcellus display, Albert Sans body, Spline Sans Mono ticket data
Crisp offset shadows for depth; no blur materials, no glass, no translucency

rules.name: The Line, Never a Fill Rule
rules.body: Gold never fills an area. It is the engraved line: double-rule borders, hairlines, the .ramp inlay thread, route-map arcs. If a surface needs a fill, it is stone (ivory/plate) or emerald.

rules.name: The Region Commit Rule
rules.body: Emerald commits at region scale or not at all: a whole tablet, the whole footer, a whole filled button. No emerald tints, washes, or pale-green backgrounds on ivory.

rules.name: The Two-Level Inscription Rule
rules.body: Only h1 and h2 wear Marcellus. Everything below the section title stays in Albert Sans.

rules.name: The Ticket Face Rule
rules.body: The mono face is reserved for ticket data (codes, fares, times, statuses). It never sets prose or headings.

rules.name: The Stone Depth Rule
rules.body: Nothing blurs and nothing is translucent — no backdrop-filter, no glass, no frosted header. Depth comes from offset shadows and engraved inset rules only.

rules.name: The Arch Frame Rule
rules.body: The cusped ogee arch is the photo-frame grammar. Featured photography hangs inside a plate, clipped to #jali-arch; bare rectangular hero photos are off-world.

rules.name: The Double Rule Rule
rules.body: The engraved gold double rule is the heading grammar and the panel border grammar. It underlines section titles (24px wide, 5px tall) and rings every plate 3px inside its edge; it is not a generic divider.

dos: Do keep gold as line-work: hairlines at rgba(164,141,41,0.45) / 0.28, the double rule, the .ramp thread; use #7d6a1d when gold must be read as small text on ivory.
Do commit emerald at region scale: whole tablets, the footer, filled buttons — with gold engraving and ivory text.
Do clip featured photography with the #jali-arch ogee clipPath inside a .panel plate.
Do set every airport code, fare, time, and PNR in Spline Sans Mono with tabular numerals.
Do use the settle-and-draw motion grammar (0.5-0.8s, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); .route-line draw 1.6s) and honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animation.
Do label the departures board and any unverifiable figure illustrative; never present mock data as live or published.
donts: Don't use kickers or eyebrows above headings. The heading grammar is the Marcellus title over the engraved double rule; small uppercase labels exist only as footer column titles and data tags.
Don't use blur, glass, translucency, or backdrop-filter anywhere — the header stays solid ivory; depth is offset shadow and engraved rule.
Don't fill any surface with gold, tint ivory with pale green, or put mint/lime accents on light grounds.
Don't bold Marcellus or use it below h2; don't set prose in the mono face.
Don't ship icon fonts or icon libraries; glyphs are inline 24px stroke SVGs in the page's own stroke system.
